notes.title: News about the save system and an Artbook!
notes.content:
Most importantly, first: yes, I’ve made the tough decision to allow more than one save file to be used in the game. When I created Lenin - The Lion, my goal was to craft an experience as close as possible to the daily decision-making process of someone living with Major Depressive Disorder. At the same time, it’s still a game, and the inherent limitations of this medium are part of the gaming experience.

That’s why, after these years of the game being available, I’ve decided to change this feature. Some players had mentioned it before, and ultimately, those who wish to experience the game as it was originally intended can still do so by using just one save file.

I hope this change allows more people to reach the end of the narrative and discover the distinct endings the game offers.

Additionally, here’s another detail: a long time ago, I promised an Artbook about the game. But it never came to fruition! Unfortunately, many challenges and external demands delayed its development—until now! I’ve recently been filled with renewed energy and am determined to finish it this year and release it [b]for free[/b]! I hope it will be an enjoyable piece of content for readers, just as it’s been a joy for me to finally bring it to life.

See you soon with the completed artbook.

Take care!

P.S.: Here are the front and back covers!

[i]Note: The artbook will initially only be available in Portuguese.[/i]

notes.title: New Achievement & keyboard instructions
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Some news for you:

All the known major bugs that could interrupt the gameplay were fixed. YAY!
If you find anything else, don't hesitate to warn me. Thank you so much for your help and understanding.
Also, I fixed an error regarding an achievement [b]"The Darkest Hour" (hands icon)[/b] and added a new one, called[b] "A Secret"[/b] (but this won't change anything in the plot).

Now on the title screen a 3 seconds image instruction appears to warn the player that[b] the game must be played with a keyboard and a mouse[/b].

That's all for now! Thank you guys and enjoy Lenin - The Lion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32574653/e809c5159fa222bb8a2116aa0b32765fbd994da6.gif[/img]

notes.title: BUGs and more
notes.content:
I'm fixing the bugs as you warn me and also as I find them in tests. Thanks for the warnings.
I'm uploading several time per day with minor fixes and you can check it out here the bug fix list.

Important Note: I disabled the option on Steam Page of [i]partially compatible Gamepad[/i] because some areas of the game may conflict in its use (pushing statues and using the ship). However, if you prefer, [b]you can still use it at other times with that in mind[/b]. I will try to optimize the use of Gamepad and will announce in a new publication as soon as possible.

[h1][b]Bugs Fixed:[/b][/h1]

Sep 27th

- Save problem (Unfortunately yesterday  between 10 p.m and 12 a.m I had to make a patch in the saves folder, which ended up [i]erasing [/i]the existing saves. The problem is fixed and will not occur again. I'm really sorry for this).
- Magnolia Bug Moving
- AX and wrong access to Mecha Wolf [b](If you get the AX with this character at the first time you visit Bipolar Woods you'll need to restart the gameplay!).[/b]
- Discography Achievement
- Clouds at background on Bipolar Woods.
- Save File corrupt after quitting the game.

Sep 28th

- Magnolia's House door opened at the Bipolar Woods return (purple version).
- 2nd Boss & key-chain error. 
- Move Lock on fire - Right Wing, Fourth Area (situational bug) 
- 3rd Boss invisible block during the escape.
- 3rd Boss Image after Boss Battle and "steam effect" on School.

Sep 29th

- Gauntlet disappears after the 3rd Boss. 
- Objects in World 4 without collision.
- Player can't move after the 4th Boss.
- Best Ending in World 3 skipping dialog.
- Cut-scene after the 3rd Boss repeating. 
- Skipping World 2 after the 1st Boss.
- Principal's Office camera error.
- Fourth Remembrance Achievement not unlocking.

Sep 30th

- Locked Door didn't show the text "locked" (Art Room)
- Options becoming unable to access after the 4th Boss.
- Some wrong notes images on menu.
- Fourth Remembrance small compared to the screen.

Oct 1st

- First Music Teacher dialog changed.
- 7th Remembrance not unlocking.

Oct 7th

- Achievement "A discography" removed since there was an error on the count number of CD's collected.

Oct 14th
- Umbrella First Equip Softlock
- Balloon on invisible character at school (night).
- New ways to find a specific note regarding The Black Panther.

- Minor grammar fixes

notes.title: Lenin - The Lion is on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Lenin - The Lion Steam Community.[/b]
I am very pleased with the arrival of Lenin's store page here on Steam and also with the creation of the Steam Community. There is still a lot to do for the production of the game, but each step is an achievement.

For those who do not know me, I am Lornyon, the solo developer of Lenin - The Lion.
If you don't know anything about the game and want to keep up with news, I'll leave here some links from the social media I use:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/leninthelion]Facebook Official Page[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/LeninTheLion] Twitter Account[/url]
[url=https://leninthelion.tumblr.com] Tumblr Account[/url]

There's a demo available for download. You can download it on [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/leninthelion/285539] GameJolt[/url] and on [url=https://lornyon.itch.io/leninthelion] Itch-io[/url].

I plan to build a demo version here, but not for now, since there're a couple of issues that I need to solve first.
I'm looking forward to the future of Lenin - The Lion and I hope you do too!
See you soon.

[b]Best Regards;
Lornyon.
